events.title: LiteLLM 1.102 reaches stable with Agent Skills and MCP controls
events.title_zh: LiteLLM 1.102 稳定版带来 Skills 与 MCP 管控
events.summary: LiteLLM 1.104.2 brings the OpenAI-compatible Decisions API and the OpenAI Decisions provider into the stable release line. The gateway can now expose `/v1/decisions` and `/v1/systemone`, extending its existing identity, MCP routing and spend controls to decision-model traffic.
events.why_it_matters: For teams centralizing model access, this avoids a separate gateway path for structured decisions. Trial it with schema validation, authentication, routing fallback and spend attribution before exposing the endpoints to production agents.
events.summary_zh: LiteLLM 1.104.2 把 OpenAI 兼容的 Decisions API 与 OpenAI Decisions provider 带入稳定版。网关现可暴露 `/v1/decisions` 和 `/v1/systemone`，让既有身份、MCP 路由与成本控制覆盖决策模型流量。
events.summary_en: LiteLLM 1.104.2 brings the OpenAI-compatible Decisions API and the OpenAI Decisions provider into the stable release line. The gateway can now expose `/v1/decisions` and `/v1/systemone`, extending its existing identity, MCP routing and spend controls to decision-model traffic.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对集中管理模型访问的团队来说，这能避免为结构化决策另建网关通道。面向生产 agent 开放前，应验证 schema、身份认证、路由回退和成本归属。
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams centralizing model access, this avoids a separate gateway path for structured decisions. Trial it with schema validation, authentication, routing fallback and spend attribution before exposing the endpoints to production agents.

technical_details.release: v1.102.0 stable; first stable PyPI artifact uploaded 2026-09-20T04:41:12.814548Z; Git tag commit 95293834e833b2d2979f87d1bd2a5be45db6728a
technical_details.agent_skills: serves registered skills through an Agent Skills well-known index and configures Claude Code or Codex with a gateway key
technical_details.mcp_controls: per-user MCP tool permissions apply to tools/list and tools/call; MCP OAuth and discovery handling improved; Conduct Guard integration added
technical_details.key_management: customer-managed KMS keys supported for virtual keys stored in AWS Secrets Manager
technical_details.observability: response headers expose the routed model, savings and complexity-routing decisions
technical_details.reliability: fixes cover spend double counting, Redis circuit-breaker state, streamed Bedrock spend buffering, secret redaction and fail-closed guardrail paths
technical_details.stabilization: backports fix request-parameter leakage, image/mask form handling, routing callback binding, streamed spend tracking, clean-snapshot fallback retries and team budget propagation
technical_details.update_2026_09_28: LiteLLM 1.103.0 stable (PyPI artifacts from 2026-09-27T17:47Z; GitHub release 2026-09-28T05:43Z): explicit Claude Code gateway endpoint, RFC 8693 IdP JWT token exchange, MCP client allowlists, live-session inspection and forced credential revocation, fail-closed upstream credentials, MCP-aware guardrails, Fuse v2 routing and budget/accounting fixes. The large RC aggregation requires production-shaped regression testing. Stays TRIAL.
technical_details.update_2026_10_05_litellm-1-104: 1.104.0 signs Docker images, rejects weak master keys, detects breached passwords, refreshes deactivated JWT user state, fixes MCP worker routing and stops unresendable spend-batch replay.
technical_details.update_2026_10_08: 1.104.2 stable backports `/v1/systemone`, the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/decisions` endpoint and the OpenAI Decisions provider from the development line.

evidence.claim_zh: LiteLLM 1.102.0 已进入 PyPI 稳定通道，保留 RC 中的 Agent Skills、Codex 与 Claude Code gateway 配置、按用户 MCP 权限、客户自管 KMS 和路由遥测。稳定化回移还修复了请求参数泄漏、流式费用统计、重试行为与团队预算继承。这个版本可以从只看 RC 的 POC 推进到受控的类生产试用。
evidence.claim_en: LiteLLM 1.102.0 has reached the stable PyPI channel with the Agent Skills, Codex and Claude Code gateway setup, per-user MCP permissions, customer-managed KMS and routing telemetry introduced in its release candidate. Stabilization backports also fix request-parameter leakage, streamed spend tracking, retry behavior and team budget propagation. The release is now suitable for a controlled production-like trial rather than an RC-only proof of concept.

evidence.claim_zh: LiteLLM 1.103.0 稳定版加入 Claude Code gateway、RFC 8693 token exchange、MCP client allowlist、在线 session 撤销与 MCP-aware 护栏，并修复多项路由和预算计费问题。
evidence.claim_en: LiteLLM 1.103.0 stable adds a Claude Code gateway, RFC 8693 token exchange, MCP client allowlists, live-session revocation and MCP-aware guardrails, alongside routing and budget-accounting fixes.
